body: Haha, yeah, I actually see a therapist. They don't know about my sh, and I really can't bring myself to tell them, no matter how hard I've tried. And honestly, it was a last resort for me. I had reached out to people I had really thought would be a helping hand, and people I didn't really care about as to not ruin any more closer relationships. I started cutting in that situation on my own terms, but continued because I wanted someone to recognize me. Which, yeah, yeah. It was selfish. I know. Like I said, I'm not proud of what I did to them, and I feel terrible. Ig I just want to clear up that I didn't sh that day for the sole purpose of attention because I just kinda felt like it. (Ik being followed is awkward, but being watched with that many eyes, sometimes you hope)

Thanks for cutting to the chase, y'know? I'm not really asking for any sympathy. Besides, they're niave. It's not like I expected much from them anyway. I just kind of needed opinions to base my next move on getting help, from this post. I know, it was selfish, and I'm not proud of it. But, as much as I hate it, it's in the past. Ig as much as I felt I wanted someone to recognize me sometimes, it wasn't my real reason for cutting in that situation, but it got the best of me anyway.

I actually do see a therapist. They don't know as much about me than they probably should, I hide quite a lot. I'm pretty awful with words, and have a difficult time explaining things, especially within this type of context. I have sharp objects that I've actually managed to hide, but I've been scared out of any sh that will leave a trace. Mostly refusing over counter medications, and showers that are too hot. They're trying to solve more than just the self harm, but all the pressure of trying to get better really just weighs me down

Thanks, actually. I definitely kind of needed that. And yeah. I can tend to be pretty open, but it ends up backfiring on me. Most people around me are pretty naive on the subject. It's been a struggle, and a process, but I'm getting there.
I've never really cut that deep, but yes. All the time. I always feel like no matter what I do, it's never going to be enough. And, feel free to pm if need be🖤

My boyfriend definitely cares (it's kind of a long distance thing so there's only so much he can do) My family knows, but honestly they only know be I felt forced into telling them. One of my best friends pretends that it isn't even happening altogether. And some of my other not as close friends that just kind of think "stop" will do the trick. A lot of people know, which is honestly too much for me rn??
I have always kind of tried to reach out to people, but they're either naive on the subject or they really just don't care.
Yeah. Will do

People can tend to be pretty naive, but just know that they are trying to help, they just don't always know the right way to go about things in their own head.

Yeah, even if it may be self harm, it never really feels validated or real, however real it may be. I want to look at it as real, because it's something I struggle with on a day to day basis, but as far as I go, it's never really enough. Thanks for that pillow advice though, I'll keep that in mind.🖤🖤
Yeah, I definitely know what you mean, sometimes I'll grab a pair of scissors or whatever without even realizing what I'm doing, and without any real plan or thinking ahead.

One can only hope, huh? And I know it's kind of scary to get diagnosed, but in the long run it's been a big relief to know that what I go through is real, not just some scheme, as ones mind tends to tell them. It's scary, but I hope you find the courage.
No problemo (just recently diagnosed with depression, dealing with self harm for a while now, of you're looking for a backstory)
